notes: Primary experimental article despite the generic title (not a review). Eleven commercial/synthesised carbons (activated carbons, activated carbon cloths, SWNT, MWNT). H2 uptake measured volumetrically at 77 K up to ~1.2 bar (Fig. 5, P axis in mbar, 0-1200; right axis wt%) and gravimetrically at 298 K up to 90 bar with helium-based manifold-volume and buoyancy correction (Fig. 6). BET areas (N2, 77 K) for all 11 samples in Table 1. Text values: ACC10, PICA, PER50, PRA50 = 2.0, 2.1, 1.98, 2.1 wt% at 77 K/1 bar (p. 7).
